plugin.name: Claude Brains
plugin.description: Develop in the IDE. Configure in the Terminal. Claude Code for JetBrains IDEs (unofficial). Runs Anthropic's official claude CLI inside PhpStorm and other IntelliJ IDEs. Complements the terminal rather than replacing it: what you reach for constantly while writing code lives in the panel, everything occasional stays in the CLI. Requires the claude CLI installed and logged in; does not bundle or redistribute Anthropic code. Not affiliated with Anthropic or JetBrains.
